profile_text.body:
Ericsson is a public company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, traded under the ticker ERIC and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000717826. On its own site the company describes itself as powering the networks that connect billions, working across 5G, AI, and cloud to serve communications providers and enterprises.

The site presents AI as embedded in network operations rather than as a standalone product line. Ericsson says it is building what it calls trusted AI for networks, and its CTO writes about four shifts shaping the network into a programmable, autonomous, and AI-native intelligent fabric. The company also describes AI-driven automation and orchestration tools for advanced 5G capabilities and network slicing, enterprise connectivity that combines 5G, AI, and cloud, and work on 6G as an intelligent fabric linking people and machines across mobile, cloud, and AI systems. It cites AT&T's Open RAN transformation as laying the foundation for an open, disaggregated, programmable network.

Beyond the company profile, the record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for Ericsson.
